title: FoxMOD
description: FoxMOD is a community driven mod that adds all the features, blocks, and crafting recipies Mojang won't. instead of me adding it all, you guys on Modrinth will request a feature to be added.
body:
The FoxMOD is different to any other mod, instead of me doing all the ideas, i am leading it up to all you on modrinth to decide! you can comment here, or visit my discord at the bottom!

the FoxMOD adds the following:
- craftable cobwebs (0.0.1+)
- a way to clear your hotbar only (Beta 0.0.1+) (/FoxMOD clear hotbar)
- a way to clear your inventory only (0.0.2+) (/FoxMOD clear inventory)
- a way to fill your entire inventory (0.0.2+) (/FoxMOD loot fill minecraft:orange_concrete 99)

the FoxMOD is available in the following versions:
- neoforge 1.21.1 0.0.1
- neoforge 1.21.1 0.0.2
- neoforge 1.21.8 0.0.2

cobwebs can now be crafted from 5 string to make 5 cobwebs, a commletly renewable way to get cobwebs.![cobweb is crafted from 5 string, one in each corner, and one in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/073dc34e2a3673466f7e2f71507093cea0f18637.png)

remember YOU yes YOU reading this, you are reading this becuase you care, send me your ideas for the next version and YOUR IDEA could change the modding community.
